summary: Exact-source r6 at commit b41c0694737d69c26db9147d04f03bd0d531d802 cleared synthesis on p53 and recovered two global-placement failure rows from the first evaluator attempt. Both recovered p53 rows reached global placement and then failed with signal 9 under worker cgroup memory pressure; p54 was not measured. A second attempt was canceled to avoid duplicating the same boundary once the first attempt's artifacts had been rescued.

measured_service_evidence.scope: p53 ideal one-group RTL/perf equivalence probe on current master
measured_service_evidence.observation: The fully instantiated folded reducer is both physically large and service-dominant: one group drains in 20730 cycles, 4.91x slower than the earlier 4224-cycle conservative producer barrier.

conclusion: R6 removed the generic-divider TECHMAP wall from r5 and proved that the folded-Mersenne hierarchy can be synthesized into a concrete 1.65M-cell structure, but the flat top remains too heavy to place as a monolith and the measured one-group service is now reducer-throughput-dominant. The next job should harden the pair-node and temporal-merge modules separately and rerun the top with macro abstraction rather than retrying another flat 1.65M-cell placement.
